teaser: What happens when the drive to lead meets a mind built to plan ten moves ahead? You are a life path 1, the number of self-rule, crossed with an INTJ, the architecture of strategy and independence. You want the same room from both sides: one where you set the terms, work from your own blueprint, and answer to no committee. The particular weight here is not in wanting to lead — plenty of numbers want that — it is in how little either side of you tolerates being told how. Where that leaves a Tuesday spent waiting for someone else's approval is worth noticing.
excerpt: A used paperback, dog-eared, waits on the counter of the bookshop you ducked into on the way home, bought for someone who reads differently than you do.
